and add-ons, partner sales reps and their commission, Vincere call logging, Workday people sync, a voice survey on the same call, Partner Academy walkthroughs in ten languages, and a round of fixes.

Packages and add-ons: a platform operator or reseller can build named packages of modules with their own prices, offer them to tenants, and put a tenant on a package with extra add-on modules. Bills show each module's price, package lines and the names you choose: modules and usage can be renamed per reseller and per tenant, and statements use the new names. Resellers can be given free licences, and a tenant can be put on a 7-day trial that warns as it runs out and ends by itself.

Partner sales reps and commission: a reseller or dealer can add its sales reps by hand or by CSV upload, link them to the clients they sold, and set commission rules. Monthly commission statements are worked out from the bills, approved and marked paid, with VAT set per employer and a Commission tab in the billing pack. Reps get their own sign-in to see My commission, and a sales team can be kept in step with Microsoft Entra by an hourly sync.

Vincere call logging: each finished call is logged as a comment on the matching Vincere candidate or contact.

Workday people sync: Workday keeps people, managers and team leaders up to date, including rehires and email changes, and imported time off can be edited once Workday is switched off. The Integration sync area retries a failed sync later by itself and Sync now runs in the background.

Voice survey: the post-call survey can be asked on the same call, by voice, beside the SMS survey.

Removing things: teams, skills, queues, lists, pools, numbers, integration clients, webhooks, sell rate cards, ticket app versions and hold music can now be removed, and a removed thing frees its name. Something still in use, such as a queue with people in it, is kept and the screen says why.

Partner Academy: walkthrough videos come from one central store, in ten languages and a choice of voices, picked in the player. A reseller administrator whose invitation waits is told so, and a platform operator can link their sign-in by hand.

Fixes: the campaign editor has a ? beside each section that explains it; Microsoft calendar sync connects a directory only from a Microsoft sign-in in that directory; the flow designer says why Save is off (steps not joined up or missing settings); opening hours can be copied to weekdays or to all days; imports, Omni and Academy wording say "Third Party" instead of the dialler's name; the Queues and Routing guide shows where call outcomes are set up; saves say what they do; and the help guides match the screens."}
